title: SMOPD: Selective Token-Entropy Masking for Dirty-History Multi-Turn On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2608.14647v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dirty-history rollouts make multi-turn on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) brittle: once a student emits an erroneous intermediate reply, later turns are conditioned on that reply, and uniform distillation can spend loss on tokens that carry little corrective signal. We introduce SMOPD (Selective Masking for On-Policy Distillation), a loss-only stabilization method for multi-turn OPSD. For each generated middle-turn reply, SMOPD ranks token positions by student entropy and removes the lowest-entropy 20% from the clipped generalized Jensen-Shannon distillation loss; final-answer and FULL-preservation losses are unchanged. This design targets token-level uncertainty rather than coarse trajectory outcomes, adds no parameters, and has zero inference-time overhead. We compare SMOPD with a correctness-scaling variant that multiplies a common detached reliability proxy using final-answer correctness. On LiC with Qwen3 models, SMOPD improves SH

translated_title: SMOPD：面向脏历史多轮在线自蒸馏的选择性令牌熵掩蔽
translated_abstract: 脏历史（dirty-history）轨迹使得多轮在线自蒸馏（OPSD）变得脆弱：一旦学生模型生成了错误的中间回复，后续轮次就会基于该回复进行条件生成，而均匀蒸馏可能会将损失浪费在携带较少修正信号的令牌上。我们提出了SMOPD（在线自蒸馏的选择性掩蔽），一种仅针对损失函数的稳定化方法，用于多轮OPSD。对于每个生成的中间轮回复，SMOPD根据学生模型的熵对令牌位置进行排序，并从裁剪后的广义Jensen-Shannon蒸馏损失中移除熵最低的20%；最终答案和完整保留损失保持不变。该设计针对令牌级不确定性而非粗粒度的轨迹结果，不增加任何参数，且推理时零开销。我们将SMOPD与一种正确性缩放变体进行比较，该变体使用最终答案正确性乘以一个常见的分离可靠性代理。在LiC数据集上使用Qwen3模型时，SMOPD提升了SH（具体指标未完整提供）。
tldr: SMOPD通过按令牌熵选择性掩蔽低信息令牌，稳定了多轮在线自蒸馏，不增加参数且推理零开销，显著提升模型性能。
en_tdlr: SMOPD stabilizes multi-turn on-policy self-distillation by selectively masking low-entropy tokens based on token-level entropy, adding no parameters and zero inference overhead, significantly improving performance.
